Folks — reviewed HelixMed's redline set. High-level notes:

1) SCCs: HelixMed added a narrow language change requiring "export controls" that would materially limit our ability to failover between EU regions. We should push back and offer a concrete operational fallback that preserves resilience.
2) Processor/Controller roles: Their redline shifts certain processor responsibilities back to Redwood (audit+data-location decisioning). We should mark any clause that changes our standard liability/indemnity.
3) Audit evidence: request for a rolling 90-day export log is larger than normal. Offer a 30-day sample and an SLA for periodic exports on request (with an ops ticket and commercial scoping if beyond the sample).

Action items for us:
- Draft a clean counter-DPA that preserves our standard SCCs language but adds a two-paragraph operational annex describing export log delivery process and KMS residency commitments.
- Prepare a redline commentary (one pager) for HelixMed's legal to explain why the SCCs ask affects failover/HA.

Laura will lead the legal draft; Jonas, Ben — please confirm if you want pricing concessions if we accept any binding export/RTO/region constraints.
